Sphinx option directive labels for command index options

submission.diagnosis: The shared pip-index-options directive appears on install, wheel, download and list pages. PipIndexOptions passes no cmd_name to the formatter, so each page emits the same unqualified bookmarks such as --index-url. The install requirements section links to these unqualified targets. This creates ambiguous duplicate targets that can resolve to another command's page; command-specific options already have a command-prefixed bookmark mechanism.
submission.proposed_change: Give index-option bookmarks an explicit unique scope, for example require the command argument on pip-index-options and pass it as cmd_name to the existing formatter. Update each directive invocation and all affected references, including the install requirements list, to the intended scoped targets. Alternatively define one canonical shared index-options destination and link to it consistently. Build documentation with duplicate-label and unresolved-reference checks, and verify generated install links land on the intended page. No documentation build has been executed in this diagnosis task.
